ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, on the left side there is the label "YB"; beside it is a rectangular symbol similar to a coil/electromagnet, with one vertical lead connected above and below the rectangle respectively. The right side of the rectangle is connected to the mechanical part on the right through a dashed line; the shape on the right looks like a brake pad or brake shoe, and is close to a vertical dashed line. According to knowledge of electrical graphic symbols, the symbol in which an energized coil acts on a brake shoe through mechanical linkage represents an electromagnetic braking device. Therefore, this symbol represents an electromagnetic brake.
